title: Arrays and lists
description:
Complete the methods. None of them may change the collections they are given.

```csharp
public static int[] Rotate(int[] values, int k)                   // move every item k places to the right, wrapping around
public static List<int> MergeSorted(IReadOnlyList<int> a, IReadOnlyList<int> b)
public static List<int> RunningTotals(IReadOnlyList<int> values)  // [1, 2, 3] gives [1, 3, 6]
public static List<string> Compact(IReadOnlyList<string?> items) // without nulls, blanks and repeats (first kept), trimmed
```

- `Rotate([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2)` is `[4, 5, 1, 2, 3]`; a negative `k` rotates left, and `k` may be larger than the length.
- `MergeSorted` merges two sorted lists into one sorted list in a single pass (do not just sort the combined list).
- `Compact` compares after trimming: `[" a", "a", null, " ", "b"]` gives `["a", "b"]`.
hints: For `Rotate`, item `i` goes to index `(i + shift) % n`, where `shift = ((k % n) + n) % n` turns any `k` into 0 to n-1.
For `MergeSorted`, keep one index into each list and always take the smaller front item; when one list runs out, copy the rest of the other.
rules: Merge in one pass instead of sorting.
